meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: Claude 会一直守着指定的 PR：按 30-60 秒轮询 CI 检查，读新评论和未解决的 review thread，把真问题改好并推送，然后重新检查；直到检查通过、没有待处理评论才停下。
howto.when: 当你说“babysit”“盯着这个 PR”等关键词，或要求持续监控 PR 的评论、review 和 CI 直到问题都解决时触发。

say.text: 帮我 babysit PR #123，直到 CI 通过、评论都处理完
say.note: 它会轮询检查并逐个处理问题

say.text: 这个 PR 还有哪些未解决的 review 评论？
say.note: 它会列出未解决的 review thread

say.text: 每 2 分钟检查一次 PR #123 的状态
say.note: 按你指定的节奏轮询状态

howto.what_en: Claude keeps watching a pull request: it polls CI checks every 30-60 seconds, reads comments and unresolved review threads, fixes issues, runs tests, pushes and rechecks. It stops only when checks pass and nothing actionable remains.
howto.when_en: Use when asked to babysit, monitor or keep checking a PR's comments, reviews and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until CI passes and all comments are handled
say_en.note: It polls checks and works through the issues

say_en.text: Which review comments on this PR are still unresolved?

say_en.note: It polls at the cadence you set
